rationale: Record a robustness fix to the gradient oracle: tools/import-validation/chrome_gradient_oracle.py stops treating headless Chrome's exit status as the verdict and instead accepts a run only when the screenshot PNG exists, decodes and has the requested size, failing loudly otherwise. Chrome 156 writes a complete screenshot and then exits 2 when its teardown watchdog expires, which made every oracle case raise. A fake-Chrome selftest (import-validation-chrome-gradient-oracle-selftest) pins success on PNG-then-exit-2 and failure on no PNG, a wrong-size PNG and an unreadable PNG. The import-design skill gains the matching gotcha for any other direct --screenshot launcher. The Chrome command line, capture semantics, DesignIR, rendering, thresholds and packaging are unchanged. Registered as watch-only so family coverage stays honest. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
